parsed.summary: The PR introduces a change to detect if Python was launched with the `-m` option, but it may not handle all edge cases correctly.

issues.description: The change does not handle cases where the script name refers to a directory or zipfile, which can cause the `__main__.__spec__.parent` to be an empty string instead of the expected package name.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the behavior of the change in different scenarios, such as when the script name refers to a directory or zipfile.
